description: DreamVoice — AI Voice Studio UI prototype (React + Vite + TS + Tailwind + shadcn/ui, dark SaaS theme, left sidebar nav)

files.purpose: Routes all pages inside Layout; single root route to Studio
Dark left sidebar: Studio/My Voices/Projects/Settings links + soon-items (Voice Changer, Dubbing, Transcripts, Subtitles, YouTube) + Usage/Help/Account footer
Studio dashboard: quick actions, recent projects, upload workspace, voice changer workspace with voice cards/settings sliders, processing state, result preview — mock simulated states
Voice library with cards (preview/use/edit/delete) and Create Voice dialog with rights confirmation checkbox gating creation
Kanban project board (Draft/Processing/Ready/Published) with search, duplicate, delete
Tabbed settings (Profile/Security/Preferences) with validation, toasts, preference toggles
